title: Antimicrobial activity of compound VG2: Part-III
abstract: In earlier paper, the synthesis of VG2 (benzamide derivative) was reported. The antimicrobial activity of VG2has been reported in part-II in continuation of part-I synthesis of the VG2. The compound was evaluated at single dose of 20nmoles in the antimicrobial screening. The mixture of microbial culture was evaluated against the VG2.The process involved standard, vehicle and control. The standard being Brand X disinfectant, control being Water and vehicle being ethanol. Test being the compound VG2 dissolved in ethanol, 20nmoles in strength and being evaluated.
